definition: Nothing here prices a plan. Each named error records roughly what its shortcut saves, and a building-code finding is advisory model text, never a permit review and never rendered as compliance.
basis: Our wording of what the workbench does not do. schema/fault.schema.json, of the cost a fault records: "Roughly what the shortcut saves, because the argument for doing it right has to survive contact with a budget." build/plan_check.py, of code findings: "They are the IRC model text, routinely amended locally, and must never be treated as a permit review."
